package.name: trnav_2ws_kinematics
package.description: QD (Quad-Drive diagonal) platform kinematics: TwoWsInverseKinematics (DualSteer IK), TwoWsCrabInverseKinematics (CRAB sideways IK), TwoWsBicycleModel. Pure math (stdlib only, no ROS). Moved out of trnav_2ws_motion per AD-012 amendment (2026-07-04) to collect QD/DD kinematics under src/Control/Kinematics/. Identifiers keep the AD-012 triple prefix (files qd_*, classes TwoWs*, namespace trnav::motion::two_ws).
